summary: Grifols filed a Form 6-K containing the call for its Ordinary General Shareholders' Meeting to be held June 17-18, 2026. The agenda covers routine items: approval of annual accounts and management report for FY2025, allocation of results, re-election of Deloitte as auditor, appointment of sustainability assurance provider, re-election of board members, amendments to board regulations and remuneration policy, consultative vote on remuneration report, authorization for board to call extraordinary meetings, and delegation for capital increases up to 50% with possible exclusion of pre-emptive rights up to 20%. This is a routine shareholder meeting notice with no special-situation event.
